correctness.rationale: The source explicitly fixes directed multihomomorphisms (nonempty A,B,C with all A→B→C→A arcs) in Paley tournament P19, not the directed flag complex. The intersections B_A=∩out(A), C_AB=∩in(A)∩out(B) exhaust all 20,862 product-simplex cells with f-vector (855,5130,9234,4959,684). Independent exact GF2 rank of all four boundary matrices is (854,4276,4275,684), yielding mod-two Betti (1,0,683,0,0). Universal coefficient comparison bounds rational Betti dimensions by mod-two dimensions; Euler characteristic 684 forces rational H2 dimension exactly 683 and H0=1. Signed oriented-cell Lefschetz character for affine group 19⋊9 has traces 683 at identity, 8 at order-three dilations a=7,11, and -1 otherwise; checked independent selected group elements. Character arithmetic gives 5·1 + 6V3 + 3V9 + 36W19 (dimension 683); averaging gives 5 invariant H2 classes, equal to rational quotient homology. Independent rank code recomputed complete cells and matrices, not merely a saved verification marker. Unrestricted claim is finite exact at P19; no integral homotopy type is asserted.

value.rationale: An exact all-cell rational-homology and rational affine-representation classification for a natural 19-vertex highly symmetric Paley tournament answers a nontrivial topological invariant rather than arbitrary small-case tabulation. The affine quotient has exactly five top-dimensional classes; the result sharply distinguishes directed Hom from published flag-complex calculations.
